scope: Retrospective reported school construction-contract cost, nominal USD
features: physical: independent gross/net area, ratio, student density, year; school type, scope, district; omit teachers/class counts

selection.eligibility: MAPE, P95 APE, CVaR90 (mean worst ceil(0.1*n) errors), max APE and count APE>1 no worse than global median; max APE no worse than baseline in every temporal fold

diagnostic: Same previously exposed 64 projects and fixed five; no independent acceptance
calibration: 2024 only; 46 rows; nominal 90% multiplicative interval; no selection
support_review: training-only 1%/99% bounds of net/gross ratio, gross area, net area; unknown scope; classroom heuristic. Flags do not remove rows from full-cohort metrics.
stop_rule: One frozen candidate selection and diagnostic evaluation; no post-result retuning

execution_repair.after_version19: Missing net areas caused NaN targets before net-family fitting; no diagnostic labels scored. Preserve data/candidates/ranking.
execution_repair.net_area_scale: Use observed positive net area; else gross area times median positive net/gross ratio fitted within each training fold, then on development for final model.
execution_repair.support_summary: Use finite observations (nanquantile) for feature bounds.
